label: calendar-day intervals between self-reported menstrual cycle day-one markers
limitations: Synthetic summary; IDs refer to no real person or source record.
Includes only the person's explicit cycle day-one markers; generic bleeding records are not converted into cycle markers.
Intervals are calendar-day differences between reported markers and do not confirm bleeding cause or a biological cycle phase.
No ovulation, fertility, conception, hormone level, diagnosis, or future onset is inferred.
The preceding boundary marker is outside the selected window but is an input that requires its own selection and authorization.
